result.summary: The main visual issue is a UI bug where the 'Trattoria Piccolo' restaurant name is cut off, making it incomplete and potentially confusing for users.

issues.description: The name of the restaurant 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated at the end of the text container within the 'Fastest near you' section.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the container width, reduce font size slightly, or allow text wrapping to ensure the full name of the establishment is visible.
